trajectory_summary: The call opens warm and stays cooperative throughout, with the customer doing much of the qualifying work unprompted (bill, kWh, roof type, EVs). The rep executes the script mechanically and books an appointment, but leaves real leverage — the EV enthusiasm signal and the bill-flip — unused, and the close lacks a firm handshake or full recap.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day and time were agreed by both sides for an in-person visit; the wife was identified as co-owner on the title but never explicitly confirmed to be present at the appointment.

bill_anchor_audit.bill_quote: And we used about 10,000 kilowatt hours
bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Bill amount and kWh usage were captured cleanly ($150-250/month, 10,000 kWh/year) but the rep never reflected it back as the reason to act; the flip should have landed right after capture at 03:16 or when booking the appointment, e.g. tying the bill pain to what the appointment will solve.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: Customer's stated reason (rising EV-driven electric usage) was acknowledged with a tangent about Tesla's self-parking feature but never reinforced later when confirming the appointment or closing the call.
